sources.title: GS-RGBN, CVPR 2025, Tables 2 and 3 / Figure 6
sources.observation: Uses w/o labels for removed components and Full model; compact tables separate input-view count from reconstruction metrics.

design_decisions: Use w/o GCM, w/o CCM and Ours. Define Generative Completion Module (GCM) and Cross-Component Memory (CCM) in both method sections. GCM combines the scene-conditioned flow transformer and constrained sampling; CCM exchanges context within GCM.
Keep two 9-pt single-column tables with matching width and one-line headers; metric names, units and direction arrows share the same baseline.
Group input sensitivity by T in the first column, spanning the two comparison rows. Put the ablated variant before the full model consistently.
Use horizontal booktabs rules and no vertical grid; avoid a nine-metric-column pivot that would require a wider table or smaller font.
Represent the author-withdrawn Obs-Reg entry by a dash, exclude it from best-value selection, and remove the corresponding zero-regression prose.
author_follow_up: Use Ours as the full-model label and component names for both ablated variants. Use single-line headers with metric name, unit and arrow together.

GCM.ablation: Bypass completion; disable opacity for non-observed, non-sky queries.

CCM.ablation: Replace shared cross-component memory with isolated per-component memories.

validation.method_change: Name existing modules GCM and CCM; formulas and algorithms unchanged.
